# SHINE VI list fixtures

These images contain only the opaque Erda Link banner, skill rows, and scrollbar.
They are 298 × 279 crops, with no character names, chat, or surrounding game scene.
Tests place them on blank client canvases and simulate the 1440p filtered stretch.

`readings.json` records actual PP-OCRv6 results, keyed by crop shape and SHA-256.
Full-screen source captures stay in the ignored `.build` directory.
